claims.assertion: Yazhi says natural doppelgangers may be soul-manifested copies or bilocation; other cases may involve portals or spacecraft, and their mechanisms remain poorly understood.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She distinguishes these possibilities from ordinary people who merely look alike.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says doppelganger cases can repeat life events and produce identical photographs even when the circumstances leading to each image differ.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She calls the phenomenon poorly understood and says similar appearances alone do not establish a mirror.

review_flags: The speakers discuss an unverified paranormal phenomenon and explicitly offer multiple possible explanations.
coverage_gaps: The conversation also discusses possible tulpas, semi-physical duplicates, and cases that allegedly disappear.
